header.name: Bottles of XP
header.description: v1.1.1 - Trade Bottles o' Enchanting for 7 XP each at a crafting table, and back again, or pack nine into one gilded blackstone.

modules.description: Four crafting recipes and the four placeholder items they make.

settings.text: §lBottles of XP§r - trade Bottles o' Enchanting for 7 XP each at a crafting table, and back again.
§7Changes here take effect the next time the world loads.§r

§7On: nine Bottles o' Enchanting pack into one gilded blackstone at a crafting table, and one gilded blackstone unpacks into nine - including gilded blackstone found in bastions. Off: both recipes still show, but whatever they make is handed straight back.§r
§7Mine placed gilded blackstone with Silk Touch. Without it, the block can break into gold nuggets, and the nine bottles in it are gone.§r
